correctness.rationale: For GP(10,2), the exact bitmask recurrence α(M)=min(4,max(α(M\{i}),1+α(M\N[i]))) independently enumerated 12,217 nonempty faces and f=(20,190,1140,3335,4632,2660,240). Independently implemented the stated ordered vertex-matching algorithm: precisely 6,031 disjoint incident pairs, one critical zero-cell and 154 critical 5-cells. Directly formed all 57,940 Hasse covers, reversed matched arrows and topologically sorted all 12,217 faces, proving acyclicity and thus an integral wedge of 154 S5 by Forman (not merely mod-two homology). Independently enumerated all 120 automorphisms using graph isomorphisms and computed the signed fixed-face reduced Lefschetz traces. The eight (cycle type, multiplicity, trace) classes exactly match the source: identity 154; 2^8 1^4: -10 (15); noncentral 2^10:-6 (15), central 2^10:+6 (1); 3^6 1^2:+4 (20); 6^3 2:0 (20); 5^4:-1 (24); 10^2:+1 (24). Their sum is zero; no rational invariant top-homology class.
residual_risks: Computer-assisted exhaustive proof depends on correctness of the simple independently implemented bitmask and topological-sort algorithms; not a formal assistant proof.
